Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Samples of product must be submitted to buyer premises for quality inspection before BID end date. Other clauses as below: 1. Statutory Compliance & Manufacturing Authorization Clause "Mandatory Compliance with Fertilizer (Control) Order (FCO): The offered product (Or ganic Manure / Fermented Organic Manure / City Compost / Vermicompost) must strictly conf orm to the specifications laid down under the Fertilizer (Control) Order (FCO), 1985 and i ts subsequent amendments. The bidder must be the actual manufacturer or an authorized distributor/channel partner of t he manufacturer who holds a valid Certificate of Manufacture issued by the designated St ate/Central Registering Authority under the FCO. A copy of the valid Certificate of Manufactur e and valid fertilizer wholesale/retail license must be uploaded along with the bid document." 2. Quality Certification and Testing Clause

"Quality Assurance and Batch Testing: 1. The supplied material must meet all parameters mandated for organic fer tilizers under FCO standards (including moisture content, organic carbon, C:N ratio, pH, and heavy metal limits). 2. Each supply batch/consignment must be accompanied by a Batch Analy sis / Quality Test Report from an NABL-accredited laboratory or a Stat e Fertilizer Control Laboratory confirming compliance with FCO parameter s. 3. The buyer reserves the right to draw random samples from the supplied s tock at the delivery destination and send them to an independent NABL-a ccredited lab for testing. If the sample fails to meet FCO specifications, th e entire lot shall be rejected at the risk and cost of the supplier, and penal action will be initiated." 3. Packaging and Marking Clause "Packaging, Labeling, and Statutory Markings: The organic manure must be supplied in secure, undamage d, tamper-proof bags. Every bag must bear clear stencil/prin ting displaying: Name of the product (e.g., Organic Manure / Vermico mpost / Fermented Organic Manure) Name and address of the manufacturer FCO specification details, nutrient content (Organic C arbon percentage, NPK content where applicable) Batch number, date of manufacture, and net weight. Unmarked, unlabelled, or improperly packed bags will be su mmarily rejected." .
